data.name: Color Cascade
data.concept: Physics-based color mixing puzzle. Paint flows, mixes, and creates new colors. You control gravity and barriers to guide the flow. Each level has a target color to create by mixing primary colors.
data.hook: Paint flows like liquid, mixes realistically, and you engineer the solution
data.controls: Click to toggle barriers. Space to flip gravity. R to restart.
data.scoring: Stars based on moves + time. Perfect solutions unlock bonus levels.
data.winCondition: Create the target color in the collection bucket
data.loseCondition: Wrong color reaches bucket or paint escapes

data.name: Echo Runner
data.concept: Temporal platformer where your past runs become the level. Record a 10-second run, then your ghost replays it as solid platforms/hazards. 5 phases per level, each adding another ghost.
data.hook: You are building the level AND beating it simultaneously
data.controls: Arrow keys to move/jump. Space to start recording. Must survive 10 seconds.
data.scoring: Time to complete all 5 phases. Fewer deaths = higher rank.
data.winCondition: Complete all 5 phases reaching the exit
data.loseCondition: Die 10 times or hit a ghost hazard

data.name: Void Siphon
data.concept: Risk/reward energy extraction puzzle. Void pockets contain energy. Siphon it by clicking, but each siphon risks collapse. Balance greed vs survival. Energy powers your base.
data.hook: The more you take, the higher the risk. But you NEED that energy.
data.controls: Click void pockets to siphon. Space to bank energy. R to retreat.
data.scoring: Total energy banked. Combo multipliers for consecutive successful siphons.
data.winCondition: Reach target energy without collapsing a void
data.loseCondition: Any void collapses = immediate game over
